background.prompt: Create a background with a light mint green base color. Place a large mustard yellow rectangle in the upper-left corner (this template: Healthy Food), covering approximately 10–32% across and 20–26% down. Add another mustard yellow rectangle in the lower-right corner, covering about 68–90% across and 47–64% down. Include a mustard yellow rectangle in the center-right, covering about 36–63% across and 47–77% down. In the lower-left corner, draw a detailed line illustration of a salad bowl in white, occupying about 0–35% across and 59–100% down. Add small black icons (phone, email, web, location) vertically aligned in the lower-right corner, about 73–91% across and 75–90% down. Ensure a clean, flat design style with no gradients or shadows. A separate round photo layer covers the upper-center of the frame (about 36–64% across, 3–43% down): draw no circle, ring, frame, shadow or photo there — keep plain background surface, as if the canvas physically ended at that boundary; do not let the scene, gradient or lighting reach into it even faded. A separate round photo layer covers the upper-right of the frame (about 68–100% across, 0–42% down): draw no circle, ring, frame, shadow or photo there — keep plain background surface, as if the canvas physically ended at that boundary; do not let the scene, gradient or lighting reach into it even faded. A separate round photo layer covers the lower-left of the frame (about 0–35% across, 59–100% down): draw no circle, ring, frame, shadow or photo there — keep plain background surface, as if the canvas physically ended at that boundary; do not let the scene, gradient or lighting reach into it even faded. No text, lettering, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.
background.notes: Keep the areas for the round photo layers in the upper-center, upper-right, and lower-left corners clear for separate photo layers. Text fixed in dark (rgb(84, 84, 84)) sits in the lower-right of the frame (about 68–79% across, 67–73% down); the upper-left of the frame (about 10–32% across, 20–26% down), so there the background must stay a light, calm tone that it reads clearly on — never dark or busy, even when a brief asks for a moody palette. Text fixed in black sits in the middle-left of the frame (about 3–32% across, 28–60% down); the lower-right of the frame (about 74–91% across, 87–90% down); the lower-right of the frame (about 74–89% across, 83–85% down); the center of the frame (about 36–63% across, 47–77% down); the lower-right of the frame (about 74–90% across, 79–81% down); the lower-right of the frame (about 73–84% across, 75–77% down); the middle-right of the frame (about 68–90% across, 47–64% down), so there the background must stay a light, calm tone that it reads clearly on — never dark or busy, even when a brief asks for a moody palette. The photo frames are separate layers; a regenerated background must not contain its own circles, rings or photos under them.
